meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会帮你安装 OneCLI 并把写在 .env 文件里的密钥(如 Anthropic 的 API key)搬进 OneCLI 保险库。之后密钥由保险库统一管理,在请求时才注入,容器里的程序看不到原始密钥。
howto.when: 当你运行 /update-nanoclaw 后 OneCLI 被作为破坏性变更引入,或需要首次搭建 OneCLI 时;也可以直接要求「初始化 OneCLI」来触发。

say.text: 运行 init-onecli,把 .env 里的密钥迁到保险库
say.note: Claude 会安装 OneCLI 并迁移凭据

say.text: 初始化 OneCLI,用我的 Claude 订阅配置
say.note: 会引导你另开终端跑 claude setup-token

say.text: 初始化 OneCLI,用 Anthropic API key 配置
say.note: 会引导你从官网取 API key 并注册

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI, configures the Agent Vault gateway, migrates existing .env credentials into it. Credentials are then managed by OneCLI and injected at request time, so container agents never see raw keys.
howto.when_en: Runs after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup. Triggered by asking to run /init-onecli.

say_en.text: Run init-onecli and migrate the .env credentials to the vault.
say_en.note: Claude installs OneCLI and migrates the credentials.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI using my Claude subscription.
say_en.note: Guides you through running claude setup-token in another terminal.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI using an Anthropic API key.
say_en.note: Walks you through getting a key and registering it.
